thread:
Anita: Kicking off Hurricane15b int4 canary. Getting intermittent OOMs on warmstart under realistic chat loads. p50 is fine, p99 spikes and node freemem drops rapidly. Posting a short log slice below.

Anita: ```
[2026-03-23T15:02:12Z] infer: alloc failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
model=hurricane15b-int4 shard=3 seq_len=512 batch=2 new_tokens=200
KV_cache_usage=78% slab_frag=0.42
```

Luke: thx. what's the canary config? microbatch / prefetch / max_new_tokens?

Anita: current canary config:```
model: hurricane15b-v1-int4
replicas: 4
microbatch_size: 2
batch_timeout_ms: 12
prefetch: enabled
max_new_tokens_default: 256
slot_reserve: 0.10
soft_evict: disabled
```

Maria: my gut says fragmentation + prefetch spikes are the combo. slab allocator shows 40% fragmentation, and with prefetch we fill slabs faster so cudaMalloc fails when trimming kicks in. Try: prefetch=off, microbatch_size=1, batch_timeout_ms=8, bump slot_reserve to 0.18. That buys headroom for warm KV allocation.

Jon: also reduce max_new_tokens_default to 96 for the canary. Many of our customer prompts don't need 256 and that limits worst-case allocation. Add a KV trim threshold and enable soft_evict so large prefix caches can be reclaimed without hard OOM. Example rollout patch:```
set rollout.hurricane15b.canary {
  overrides: {
    max_new_tokens_default: 96,
    microbatch_size: 1,
    prefetch: false,
    slot_reserve: 0.18,
    soft_evict: true,
    kv_trim_pct: 0.25
  }
}
```

infra-bot: ALERT: node-gpu-12 OOM at 2026-03-23T15:01:58Z while running hurricane15b-canary-3. Stack: runtime/infer.cu:423 alloc.cu:88

Sam: we'll want a quick quant-quality check after config changes. Please run the quant-eval harness (conversational-smoke-set + adversarial prompts) to ensure int4 still matches baseline. Command we use:```
./eval_harness --model hurricane15b-v1-int4 --evalset conversational-smoke-set --metrics rouge,bleu,semantic_sim --run-id canary-6155 --save-diffs
```
Also ping Prometheus on mem/cuda_free and the per-shard slab_frag gauge.

Priya (QA): I can run the harness and eyeball diffs. If we reduce max_new_tokens we should also run a small A/B on throughput vs quality (10k requests). I can own that.

Anita: plan then: 1) flip prefetch off + microbatch=1 + soft_evict on 2) reduce max_new_tokens_default to 96 3) enable kv_trim_pct=0.25 4) run quant-quality eval and 10k A/B traffic with fallback to 13b if we see regressions. Who can do 1-2 now?

Luke: I can push the rollout patch for 1-2 and watch infra metrics for the next hour.

Maria: I'll prepare the slab defrag snapshot script so we can compare before/after fragmentation numbers. Putting it in the canary runbook.

Sam: starting eval harness now, will post results link when done: http://bench.example.internal/run/6155

Anita: awesome. Luke please keep an eye on any sudden latency regressions — microbatch=1 may spike p50 a bit. We'll prefer latency SLOs over memory OOMs, but we want both stable. I'll update the incident thread if things change. :thumbsup: 

Priya (QA): noted, I'll kick off the 10k A/B once Sam posts eval pass. ETA ~90m.

Anita: thanks team — running the canary patch in 2 mins. Will report back with metrics and logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
